QR SLOP · In development

QR code generator

QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, contacts and more. Nothing uploaded.

Open now

QR SLOP has these main features: Text, links, email, phone, SMS, Wi-Fi, vCard, location and events; Colours, error correction and a transparent background.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with QR SLOP

  • Make a Wi-Fi QR code
  • Make a QR code with your logo
  • Make a vCard QR code for your contact details
  • Make many QR codes at once
  • A free QR Code Monkey alternative in your browser
